Cargo.toml.content:
[package]
name = "proteus-coding-workflow-module"
version = "0.1.0-alpha.3"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT"
publish = false

[package.metadata.proteus]
id = "coding-workflow"
implementation = "workflow/coding-workflow"

[[bin]]
name = "proteus-coding-workflow-module"
path = "src/main.rs"
test = false
bench = false

[dependencies]
proteus-module-runtime = { path = "../module-runtime" }
coding-workflow = { path = "../../workflow/coding-workflow", default-features = false }
